name: SKULL-5
tagline: An automatic anti-zombie sniper rifle built on the M14 EBR.
summary: SKULL-5 is an automatic anti-zombie sniper rifle: a remodel of the M14 EBR fitted with a sniper scope and fed with 24 rounds of 5.56mm Anti-Zombie ammunition. Its government-developed bullets deal critical damage to zombies and have high penetration. It is part of the SKULL series and shares its reserve ammunition with the SKULL machine guns.
description: The wiki describes SKULL-5 as a remodel of the M14 EBR attached with a sniper scope, firing specialized bullets created by the government that deliver critical damage to zombies and have high penetration power. It costs $6,000 in both Original and Scenario modes; ammunition costs $1,600 per magazine in Original and $4,000 per magazine in Scenario. Damage table (0m, armor / no armor): head 251 / 296, chest & hand 62 / 74, gut 78 / 92, leg 55 / 55; at 36m: head 238 / 280, chest & hand 59 / 70, gut 74 / 87, leg 52 / 52. A chrome-covered tournament edition, SKULL-5 World Championship, adds +40 human damage, +120 zombie damage, +150 reserve ammo, -0.5s reload and +4 clip size at the cost of -22% accuracy, +12% recoil, -9% fire rate and +4% weight.

stats.damage: Head 251 (armor) / 296 (no armor) at 0m; chest & hand 62/74; gut 78/92; leg 55
stats.rateOfFire: High when unscoped; decreases while zooming

ammo.reserve: High (shared with the SKULL machine guns)

obtainMethod: Limited availability (wiki lists it as a disadvantage)
advantages: High reserve ammunition (shared with SKULL machine guns)
trivia: First weapon in the game that fires accurately while jumping.
The chrome texture of the World Championship edition does not apply in D3D graphics mode.
